original.statement: Upgrading to Karpenter 1.0.0+ introduces v1 APIs and requires following the v1 Migration Upgrade Procedure; stored v1beta1 manifests must be migrated to v1 before v1beta1 stops being served at v1.1.0.

decision.reason: [ev-bfb089d90d84] says operators must not upgrade to 1.0.0+ without referencing the v1 Migration Upgrade Procedure, and that they must migrate all stored manifests to v1 API versions before v1beta1 stops being served at v1.1.0. That makes this a mandatory operator step, so the migration family with change type migration-required fits. The name v1-migration-upgrade-procedure comes from the evidence's own name for the procedure.
